arabic text: HAATHO ME LIYE KHAALI KUNZAA\nABBAS SAKINA ROTI HAI
english translation text: ABASS, SAKINA IS CRYING\nHOLDING AN EMPTY PITCHER

arabic text: AB TAK HAI NAZAR, SUWE DARYAA\nABBAS SAKINA ROTI HAI
english translation text: ABBAS, SAKINA IS CRYING\nTILL THIS MOMENT HER SIGHT IS GAZED AT THE RIVER

arabic text: DEKHO TO TARAI SE UTHKAR\nPATHRAAI HUI SEHMISI NAZAR
english translation text: RISE FROM THE RIVER BANK AND SEE\nHER PETRIFIED AND FEARFUL LOOK

arabic text: BE AAS NA HOJAYE DUKHYAA\nABBAS SAKINA ROTI HAI
english translation text: ABBAS, SAKINA IS CRYING\nMAY THE BROKEN HEARTED CHILD NOT BECOME HOPELESS

arabic text: TUM AYSE GHAYE JAAKAR NA FIRE\nITNA BHI NA SOCHA KYA HOGA
english translation text: YOU WENT IN SUCH A MANNER THAT YOU NEVER TURNED BACK\nYOU DIDN’T EVEN THINK OF WHAT WOULD HAPPEN

arabic text: LE AAWO KHUDAARA MASHKIZA\nABBAS SAKINA ROTI HAI
english translation text: ABBAS, SAKINA IS CRYING FOR ALLAH'S\nSAKE, BRING THE WATER SKIN (MASHK)

arabic text: TUM LAAYE NA BHAR KAR MASHKIZA\nNA AAP HI PALTE DARYAASE
english translation text: YOU DIDN'T BRING THE FILLED WATERSKIN (MASHK)\nNEITHER DID YOU RETURN FROM THE RIVER

arabic text: KYA KHUB NIBHAAYA, EHDE WAFAA\nABBAS SAKINA ROTI HAI
english translation text: ABBAS, SAKINA IS CRYING\nHOW WELL YOU FULFILLED YOUR PROMISE

arabic text: KHAAYE HAI TAMAACHE ZAALIM KE\nMAASOOM NE NANNE GHAALON PAR
english translation text: SHE BORE THE SLAPS OF THE OPPRESSORS\nON HER INNOCENT SMALL CHEEKS

arabic text: IS NEEND SE CHONKO BARAYE KHUDA\nABBAS SAKINA ROTI HAI
english translation text: ABBAS, SAKINA IS CRYING\nWAKE UP FROM THIS SLEEP FOR THE SAKE OF ALLAH

arabic text: AMMA HAI TARAPTI DEKHO CHACHA\nASGHAR KA JO HAAL NAHI DIKHTA
english translation text: LOOK UNCLE, MY MOTHER IS SO RESTLESS,\nSHE CAN NOT FIND ALI ASGHAR ANYWHERE

arabic text: ITNAATO BATAADO TUM HO KAHAAN\nABBAS SAKINA ROTI HAI
english translation text: ABBAS, SAKINA IS CRYING\nJUST TELL ME WHERE YOU ARE

arabic text: BAANDHE HAI KAMAR KO KYUN BABA\nHAATHON ME ALAM THAAME BABA
english translation text: BABA IS HOLDING THE FLAG\nWHY HAS FATHER TIED HIS BACK

arabic text: KUCH KEHTE NAHI HAI DEKHO CHACHA\nABBAS SAKINA ROTI HAI
english translation text: ABBAS, SAKINA IS CRYING\nLOOK UNCLE, HE DOESN’T SAY ANYTHING

arabic text: HILTI HAI ZAMEEN HILTAA HAI FALAK\nHAI HAASHIMI GHAM KI JINNO MALAK
english translation text: THE GROUND QUAKES, THE SKIES QUAKE\nTHE ANGELS AND JINN ARE MOURNING FOR THE HASHIMITES

arabic text: HAI EHLE HARAM ME SHOR BARPA
english translation text: THERE IS AN UPROAR IN THE HOLY HOUSEHOLD
